observations: body L1: the head of the commentary on chapter 40, set like the heads of the earlier chapters.

body L2-L4: the dash after «a)» measures 9.8 pt, the hyphen of «38-40» 3.0 pt. The place is p. 84, L38-L40 («adde, si eam e tabulis Theonis accipis, 1/18 ipsius»); the codex reading 1/38 is the note to that line, whose first figure prints filled (p. 84, notes_left L1).

body L5-L10: the dash before «Si» measures 10.3 pt. 3′ is the eighteenth part of 54′; the lunar parallax at the first limit and 90° of zenith distance in Ptolemy's table, 53′ 34″ (Almagest V, 18), rounded to 54′, as on p. 253. Theon's own 1/20 makes 2′ 41″ of 53′ 34″.
body L12: «p. 262, adn. s» is note s) there, where the effect of Theon's obliquity on the parallax is put at about 16″.
body L13-L14: the dash after «b)» measures 9.7 pt, the hyphen of «1-27» 3.4 pt; the dash after «I.» 9.7 pt, and «1–18» has a long dash (5.4 pt).
body L15-L18: on the nonagesimal see p. 262, notes L1-L2. A speck prints under «cfr.»; «al–Battānī» (L15, L33) has a long dash (5.3 and 5.4 pt).

body L19-L23: the quotation is from Tycho's Progymnasmata (note 1); «facilima» is marked [sic] for facillima. A dot prints before the E of «Eclipticae» (L20) and a speck between «vertens» and the semicolon (L22).

body L24-L29: «332–38» has a long dash (5.3 pt). In the Canon of Kings Hadrian's first year is the 864th of Nabonassar, so the 20th is the 883rd, and Athyr 13 of it is 1 October 135: «882 Nabonassaris» counts the Egyptian years then complete. 5 1/2 + 1/3 = 5 5/6 equinoctial hours after noon, as in the Almagest. A speck prints after «tropicum» (L26). The Greek of L27-L28 is the Almagest's: the Moon was then very nearly on the meridian.
body L30-L31: the dash after «II.» measures 10.1 pt, and «19–27» has a long dash (4.9 pt).
notes_left L1-L5: the dash before «In aliis» measures 7.1 pt.
notes_right L1-L5: «293-94» has a hyphen (3.1 pt); «(ed. Halma I, 304)» is printed without «t.».
